item.title: Mamdani blasted over cold weather deaths as NYC announces seven additional fatalities
item.description: These deaths are not inevitable,” Council Speaker Julie Menin said, of the NYers who have perished in the cold. “They are the result of gaps in outreach, shelter capacity, mental health services.”

item.title: Tiger Woods’ son Charlie commits to play golf at Florida State
item.description: Charlie Woods, the 17-year-old son of golf great Tiger Woods, has committed to hit the links as a member of Florida State's golf team in 2027.

item.title: French prosecutor searches for victims after a man is accused of abusing 89 minors over 55 years
item.description: Jacques Leveugle has been under investigation since February 2024.

item.title: Investigators suspect Nancy Guthrie’s kidnapper lives in Tucson: report
item.description: Authorities investigating the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie believe the person responsible for her apparent abduction lives in her hometown of Tucson.

item.title: Kanye West books first European concert in 11 years after antisemitism apology
item.description: The divisive rapper, formerly known as Kanye West, is scheduled to perform his first European concert in over a decade.

item.title: 49ers’ Keion White shot after argument with rapper Lil Baby: report
item.description: San Francisco 49er Keion White was shot following an argument with rapper Lil Baby at the football player's Super Bowl party, according to a police report.

item.title: Jalen Brunson’s 40 points not enough to erase mistakes in Knicks’ OT loss to 14-win Pacers
item.description: After winning nine out of 10 games, the Knicks have now lost two of their last three.

item.title: Person detained for questioning in disappearance of Nancy Guthrie: report
item.description: A person has been detained for questioning in the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie, according to sources familiar with the investigation.

item.title: Surge in Spanish-study seekers follows Bad Bunny Super Bowl performance
item.description: Aspiring Spanish speakers are flocking to learn the language in the wake of Bad Bunny’s Super Bowl LX halftime show.

item.title: Asking Eric: Alexa’s eavesdropping makes for uncomfortable visits with friends
